vr.look: Colonial Williamsburg is an old town in Virginia with shops. Honesty means telling the truth. Responsibility means doing what you said you would do.

steps.title: Go in
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Williamsburg in Filter environments. Click Colonial Williamsburg, then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Scout the shops
steps.html: Move with the thumbstick. Walk down the street. Look at the shops and their signs. Think about what each shop sells.

steps.title: Record your video and send it
steps.html:
Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Move the tablet until the street and the shops fit.

Click Record video. Say your 2 sentences. Click it again to stop.

Click the Canvas tab and pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your video, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 Want to fix it? Record a new video and send it again.

steps.title: Check and leave

studio.title: Market Stories
studio.look: Four short stories from a market. In each one, a person has to choose what to do. The trust meter at the top fills up when the market stays honest.
studio.do: Read the story. Tap what an honest, responsible person would do.

game.miss: Think again. Would that keep the buyer's trust?
game.done: The trust meter is full! Honesty and responsibility hold the market together.

rounds.scene: Ana caught these fish yesterday. A buyer asks, "Did you catch them today?"
options: "Yes, today!" so the buyer pays more.
"I caught them yesterday. They are still good, and the price is lower."
rounds.ok: Yes! Ana told the truth about what she is selling.
miss: That is not the truth. The buyer would stop trusting Ana.
Hiding the truth is not honest either.

rounds.scene: Ben's scale shows a little too much. Each bag of flour weighs less than it says.
options: Keep using it. No one will know.
Fix the scale so it weighs the right way.
rounds.ok: Yes! An honest seller weighs things the right way.
miss: The buyers would be cheated, even if they never find out.
That does not fix the wrong weight.

rounds.scene: Cora promised 10 sacks of grain by Friday. A storm slowed her down.
rounds.q: What is the responsible thing to do?
options: Tell the buyer early, and bring the grain as soon as she can.
Bring 5 sacks and say it is 10.
rounds.ok: Yes! Cora keeps her promise, even when it gets harder.
miss: That is not honest. The buyer counts on 10 sacks.

rounds.scene: Dev pays for apples. The seller gives back too much change by mistake.
options: Give the extra money back to the seller.
rounds.ok: Yes! Buyers are honest too. Dev pays what he agreed to pay.
miss: That money belongs to the seller.
That money is not Dev's to spend.

frames.lead: What does honesty look like in a market?

studio.full: All four stories are done, and your 2 sentences have 20 words or more.
